newsitem.title: FRANCE: Press Digest - France - Le Monde March 24.
newsitem.headline: Press Digest - France - Le Monde March 24.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Mainstream left- and right-wing parties mobilise against planned far-right National Front party congress in Strasbourg next weekend.
-- Credit Agricole expected to post a record seven billion franc profit for 1996, best in the French banking industry, but unions fear recent acquisition of Indosuez may trigger restructurings.

-- Government expects Aerospatiale to remain neutral in competition between Alcatel-Alsthom -Dassault and Lagardere for Thomson-CSF. Aerospatiale considers joint ventures in satellites and missiles with the winning bidder.
-- Renault chairman Louis Schweitzer considers deeper cost cuts to lower selling prices and boost sales.
-- Generale des Eaux seeks some return on its one-billion-franc investment in real estate projects in the southern town of Cannes, after the town's mayor was jailed for corruption.
